CSE-3174                                                                                                                     about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 08-Dec-2023 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOV/DEC 2023  
  Artificial Intelligence [CSE-3174]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Summarize the Underlying Assumptions in Artificial Intelligence. Interpret the three  
  important components of AI Technique.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Compare and contrast between Strong AI and Weak AI. List any two expert systems that  
  was influential in the field of AI during its inception.                             (3)  
  
  C)      Illustrate the tabulation for sequence of percepts and actions using an example of a  
  shopping agent on the internet.                                                               (3)  
  
  2)           With a diagrammatic illustration, a code snippet and an example discuss the concept of  
  Simple Reflex Agents.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate Hill Climbing Search with a generic algorithmic depiction. Discuss any two  
  problems and four advantages associated with Hill Climbing.                                   (3)  
  
  C)      Develop a program in an Object Oriented Programming Language of your choice to  
  implement breadth first search. Give the input graph and the output path for traversal for (3)  
  the given input on application of the breadth first search strategy,  
  
  3)           State the objective of Simulated Annealing algorithm. With either a system of  
  mathematical formulations or a pseudocode, discuss in detail the simulated annealing  
  (4)  
  algorithm in the context of optimization.  
  A)  
  B)      Interpret any four properties of the First Order Logic. List the variations of the first order  
  logic. Also, summarize the two primary characteristics of the First Order Logic.               (3)  
  
  C)      Construct the Top-Down Parse Tree for the sentence "David saw stars with eyes through  
  the telescope in Israel at around 10 pm."                                             (3)

  4)              Convert the following statements into First Order Logic:  
  (a).Every farmer who owns a donkey buys hay.  
  (b).No purple mushroom is poisonous.                                                        (4)  
  A)         (c).Every boy or girl is a child.  
  (d).Every child gets a doll or a train or a piece of coal.  
  
  B)         Illustrate and visualize graphically an Ontology for geography as a prospective domain  
  with at least 6 levels of concept, sub-concept hierarchy and at least 6 individuals.        (3)  
  
  C)         With an example of your choice discuss the Backward Chaining Algorithm to prove an  
  inferable conclusion from a set of dependent axioms.                                        (3)  
  
  5)              Construct a Knowledge Base for the following facts using FOL:  
  
  • Tony, Jim and Jake belong to the Hoofers Club  
  A)            • Every member of the Hoofers Club is either a skier or a mountain climber or both  
  • No mountain climber likes rain, and all skiers like snow  
  • Jake dislikes whatever Tony likes and likes whatever Tony dislikes               (4)  
  • Tony likes rain and snow  
  
  Also, using Backward Chaining to prove the fact "Jake is a mountain climber but not a  
  skier"  
  
  B)         Discuss in detail on how domain knowledge can have an influence in yielding quick  
  convergence to optimality through reasoning in Expert Systems. Justify with an example (3)  
  on how Domain Knowledge is represented and integrated in Expert Systems.  
  
  C)         In the context of Knowledge Centric Systems, discuss how Knowledge Represented  
  have influenced intelligent information systems. Correlate this with a case study by  
  comparing the information system considered using Machine Learning Techniques and           (3)  
  Knowledge Based AI Techniques which can also include Machine Learning. Which  
  among the two classes of systems will converge to optimality at a quicker rate. Justify.  
  
  
  -----End-----
